description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for DevOps security, including methods to check if status endpoints are secured with BasicAuth and to retrieve relevant passwords. It also includes an inner enum listing configuration keys and default values related to DevOps security settings.

classes.name: DevOpsConfig
classes.description: An interface providing security configuration settings for DevOps endpoints, such as whether status resources are secured with BasicAuth and the associated passwords.

classes.name: DevOpsConfig.DevOpsConfigValue
classes.description: An enum listing configuration keys and default values for DevOps security settings, implementing the KnownConfigValue interface.

methods.name: isSecureStatus
methods.description: Indicates whether DevOps status resources are secured with BasicAuth.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the BasicAuth password for all DevOps resources.

methods.name: getStatusPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the BasicAuth password specifically for status resources.
